experiment_data.hypothesis: Per-layer MSE loss baseline: ||down_proj(dense_act * mask) - down_proj(dense_act)||² trains predictor to minimize output reconstruction error per layer. Reviewer-requested "Intermediate" baseline comparing against KL (distribution-level) and BCE (binary classification) approaches. If MSE significantly underperforms KL, validates that distributional knowledge transfer > per-layer output matching for sparsity prediction.
